Connor Vinderblad is the deceased husband of  Mayrina and is in a coffin behind the Riverside Teahouse.

Involvement

Act One

Connor's untimely death drove  Mayrina to seek help from the hag  Auntie Ethel, who created a special magic wand to "bring back" Connor in exchange for Mayrina's unborn child. Upon defeating Ethel, the party can take the wand  Bitter Divorce and use it on Connor's corpse behind the teahouse. If she survives, Mayrina is horrified to see that, contrary to her expectations, Connor is not resurrected as his former self, but only reanimated as an undead zombie. The party can either give the wand to Mayrina or keep it for themselves. If kept, it transformes to  Second Marriage and can summon Connor at any time. If Mayrina is surrendered to Ethel, then using the wand on Connor's corpse resurrects him as a hostile entity.

If Bitter Divorce is used on Connor's corpse without going through the dialogue with Mayrina, Connor comes back to life with 1 HP, and after a short cut-scene becomes hostile. Killing Connor yields no experience and causes Bitter Divorce to disappear from the party's inventory. Bitter Divorce can be dropped before killing Connor and picked up again after the fight to avoid this.

Act Three

If Bitter Divorce is given to Mayrina in the Act One, Connor jouneys with Mayrina to Old Garlow's Place. Otherwise if Bitter Divorce is kept, Mayrina reacts to Connor being summoned nearby.

Combat

Connor's Undead form can be summoned using the wand  Second Marriage. Having only a basic unarmed attack, his offensive capability is limited, but his low AC leads enemies to target him. Combined with  Undead Fortitude preventing one killing blow, he can reliably waste at least two enemy actions.

Connor is permanently afflicted with the  Stench condition (labeled as 'smelly' in-game), which is unique to Connor and makes him smell bad.

Notes

  • It is not possible to use  Speak with Dead on Connor.
  • Connor's body can be picked up and stored at the camp.
  • After killing Connor once, he can no longer be summoned with Bitter Divorce.

Bugs

  • There seems to be a bug where it is possible to forcibly resurrect Connor with the wand by double clicking on his body with the wand. If the party leave the area and allow him to heal then they can kill and resurrect him. The party must then offer items or gold to him to improve their relationship.[verify]
